title: Hotbar Swap Mod
description: This Mod Can Swap The Hotbar and Helps In Content Creation.
body:
This Mod Can Swap The Hotbar and Helps In PvP and In Content Creation.

-✅This mod can directly swap the player hotbar items without opening their inventory.
-✅This mod can be used in PvP to swap items in the hotbar, improving efficiency and speed.
-✅This mod can be used in content creation to swap items in the hotbar, improving the player's experience.

This mod will work like when you scroll down the mouse button from slot 9 then the hotbar swap with next hotbar and when you scroll up the mouse button from slot 1 then the hotbar swap with previous hotbar.
